Overview

Every project starts as a plain folder of notes, and the team decides together when a note is ready to leave the draft stage and join the shared record.

Reviews happen in the open: anyone can comment on a change, and the author answers each comment before the change is merged into the main line of work.

Retention

Access is granted per project rather than per person, so moving someone between teams never means re-sharing a long list of individual files by hand.

Automations run with the same permissions as the person who created them, so a script can never reach further than its owner could reach on their own.

Every export keeps its original timestamps and authorship, which makes audits quick and keeps the history readable for people who join the team much later.
